segments.text: You already have a powerful GPU in the cloud. It's just stuck inside a browser tab.
Meet NZAP Engine. Your own Google Colab runtimes, in a native app.
Connect your Google account once. No servers, no sign-ups, and your token never leaves your keychain.
Pick an app, like Kokoro text to speech. NZAP shows you the GPU it needs, and how long it will take, before you press a thing.
Hit generate. NZAP starts a T4, installs everything, and loads the model on Colab, not on your laptop.
Seconds later, you're listening to the result. And the next run is instant, because the model stays warm.
When you need more, there's a real terminal, a file manager, notebooks with typed parameters, and jobs that clean up after themselves.
Every app is just a notebook and a small JSON file, so anyone can publish one to the community catalog.
NZAP Engine. Free, open source, and yours. Download it today.
